method: Identical fresh phone tasks, unchanged0.9 JEV gates. Hybrid admits a caller-specified exact destination app and empty field/literal directly, and uses JEV for navigation choices. App launches use CoreDevice. JEV-only sends every decision to JEV. Paired mode alternates AB/BA by task and repeat. Setup and cleanup are recorded but excluded from warm task time. recording_warm_start_ms locates that timer in the capture. Every result receives an independent fresh AX check and a result screenshot before cleanup; both are timed. Capture stops if the phone locks. All failures are retained; no failed mutation is replayed.
